name: number-field
title: Number Field
description: A number field allows a user to enter a number and increment or decrement the value using stepper buttons.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { NumberFieldRootEmits, NumberFieldRootProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { NumberFieldRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<NumberFieldRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<NumberFieldRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <NumberFieldRoot
    data-slot="number-field"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-number-field"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </NumberFieldRoot>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-number-field {
    display: grid;
    gap: calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5);
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { NumberFieldDecrementProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { NumberFieldDecrement, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { MinusIcon } from '@lucide/vue';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<NumberFieldDecrementProps>();

const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <NumberFieldDecrement
    data-slot="decrement"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-number-field-decrement"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot>
      <MinusIcon class="sigma-ui-number-field-decrement__icon" />
    </slot>
  </NumberFieldDecrement>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-number-field-decrement {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 0;
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 3);
    transform: translateY(-50%);
  }

  .sigma-ui-number-field-decrement:disabled {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 0.2;
  }

  .sigma-ui-number-field-decrement__icon {
    width: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
    height: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { NumberFieldIncrementProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { NumberFieldIncrement, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { PlusIcon } from '@lucide/vue';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<NumberFieldIncrementProps>();

const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <NumberFieldIncrement
    data-slot="increment"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-number-field-increment"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot>
      <PlusIcon class="sigma-ui-number-field-increment__icon" />
    </slot>
  </NumberFieldIncrement>
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-number-field-increment {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    right: 0;
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 3);
    transform: translateY(-50%);
  }

  .sigma-ui-number-field-increment:disabled {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 0.2;
  }

  .sigma-ui-number-field-increment__icon {
    width: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
    height: calc(var(--spacing) * 4);
  }
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { NumberFieldInput } from 'reka-ui';
</script>

<template>
  <NumberFieldInput
    data-slot="input"
    class="sigma-ui-number-field-input"
  />
</template>

<style>
@layer base, components;

@layer components {
  .sigma-ui-number-field-input {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(var(--spacing) * 10);
    padding: calc(var(--spacing) * 2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius);
    background-color: transparent;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .sigma-ui-number-field-input::placeholder {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }

  .sigma-ui-number-field-input:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }

  .sigma-ui-number-field-input:disabled {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
}
</style>
